propositions: Bare `import alert_dedup` in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py fails with ModuleNotFoundError when test files are run in isolation, because scripts/ is not on sys.path unless explicitly injected at collection time.
CI full runs mask the defect because tests/scripts/conftest.py inserts scripts/ on sys.path at collection, causing the side effect to leak into all subsequently-collected test modules.

The fix must use explicit sys.path.insert derived from __file__ immediately above the import, matching the precedent established by scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py, to work under all invocation modes (direct script execution, pytest, importlib).

An import guard test (test_scripts_import_convention.py) must verify by AST scan that all bare imports of sibling modules under scripts/ are preceded by an invocation-independent sys.path insert and confirmed by dynamic test execution.
